questions.question:
Study the given matrix carefully and select the number from among the given options that can replace the question mark(?) in it.

 
 

 13
 6
 75
 
 

 15
 8
 ?
 
 

 18
 4
 70
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

**Logic is followed horizontally.**

Third number = **(First number of the row × second number) - (second number)/2 **

So,

 
• First row :

⇒ (13 x 6) = 78 = 78 - (6/2) = 78 - 3 = 75

 
• Third row :

⇒ (18 x 4) =72 Then 72 - (4/2) = 72 - 2 = 70

Similarly,

 
• Second row :

⇒ (**15 x 8) = 120. Then,120 - (8/2) = 120 - 4 = 116**

Hence, **"116"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc714db2d6ce9a9e1221452a508d434061230fab513a2d1d4db0cb098bcea1fe.png]
questions.solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7cc86211bea35541dd1cf395832089cb36df0e83a7c356e520ca907b20bf648.png] 

**⇒ As the alternate positions becomes opposite to each other and the remaining two faces becomes opposite to each other.**

So, opposite pairs are:

 
• 1 → 4
 
• 2 → 6
 
• 3 → 5

Therefore,

 
• **Option(1)** → 4 and 6 ⇒ Not opposite (As 4 is opposite to 1 and 6 is opposite to 2)
 
• Option(2) → 1 and 5 ⇒ Not opposite (As 1 is opposite to 4 and 5 is opposite to 3)
 
• Option(3) → 3 and 5 ⇒ Opposite

Hence, **"3 and 5"** is the correct answer.

54 * 36 * 12 * 18 * 24 * 24
In a certain code language, 'RAHUL' is coded as 180, and 'POOJA' is coded as 171. How will 'RAJIV' be coded in the same language?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

**Logic : Added all the position values of each letter and then multiplied by 3.**

So,

 
• RAHUL is coded as :

⇒ According to alphabetic series position values of "RAHUL" is → 18 + 1 + 8 + 21 + 12 = 60 

⇒ 60 x 3 = 180

 
• POOJA is coded as :

⇒ According to alphabetic series position values of "POOJA" is → 16 + 15 + 15 + 10 + 1 = 57

⇒ 57 x 3 = 171

Similarly,

 
• RAJIV is coded as :

⇒ According to alphabetic series position values of "RAJIV" is → 18 + 1 + 10 + 9 + 22 = 60 

⇒ 60 x 3 = 180

Hence, **"180"** is the correct answer.

P_ _ N _ _ S R _ Q P _ R _ _ _ S _ N Q

options.text: S, R, Q, P, N, S, N, Q, P, R
S, R, Q, R, N, Q, N, S, P, R
R, S, Q, P, R, S, R, Q, P, N
Q, R, S, P, N, S, N, Q, P, R

questions.solution:
Given : P_ _ N _ _ S R _ Q P _ R _ _ _ S _ N Q

By checking options :

 
• S, R, Q, P, N, S, N, Q, P, R → P __**S**__ __**R**__ N __**Q**__ __**P**__ S R __**N**__ Q P __**S**__ R __**N Q P**__ S __**R**__ N Q → (It follows the pattern of : **PSRNQ - PSRNQ - PSRNQ - PSRNQ**)
 
• S, R, Q, R, N, Q, N, S, P, R → P __S__ __R__ N __Q__ **__R__** S R __N__ Q P **__Q__** R __N S P__ S __R__ N Q → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• R, S, Q, P, R, S, R, Q, P, N → P **__R__** **__S__** N __Q__ **__P__** S R **__R__** Q P **__S__** R __**R** Q P__ S **__N__** N Q → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• Q, R, S, P, N, S, N, Q, P, R → P **__Q__** **__R__** N **__S__** __P__ S R **__N__** Q P __S__ R __**N** Q P__ S **__R__** N Q → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)

⇒Option - (1) gives the pattern of " P __S__ __R__ N __Q -__ __P__ S R __N__ Q **-** P __S__ R __N Q P -__ S __R__ N Q "

questions.question: In a certain code, 692425 means 'School education is free in India' and 7926 means 'College education is costly'. Which of the following is the code for 'I want to become graduate'?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

**Logic : Digits represent the number of letter in a single word in the serial order of the sentence.**

So,

 
• 692425 means 'School education is free in India'

⇒ School → 6 letters word

⇒ education → 9 letters word

⇒ is → 2 letters word

⇒ free → 4 letters word

⇒ in → 2 letters word

⇒ India → 5 letters word

 
• 7926 means 'College education is costly'

⇒ College → 7 letters word

⇒ education → 9 letters word

⇒ is → 2 letters word

⇒ costly → 6 letters word

Similarly, 

 
• 'I want to become graduate'​

⇒ I → 1 letter word

⇒ want → 4 letters word

⇒ to → 2 letters word

⇒ become → 6 letters word

⇒ graduate → 8 letters word

Hence, **"****14268"** is the correct answer.

questions.question: In a group of 110 students, 23 students did not participate in any of the two games: Badminton and Chess. 45 students participated in Badminton and 61 students participated in Chess. How many students participated in Badminton only?
questions.solution:
Given : In a group of 110 students, 23 students did not participate in any of the two games: Badminton and Chess, 45 students participated in Badminton and 61 students participated in Chess.

So,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f9cb7b8bf5628b1ac63b17af942813b6a40c8c35af5d10209ad592351d01c153.png] 

Total students = 110

Students did not participate in any of the two games = 23

Therefore, students who participated (a +b + c) = 110 - 23 ⇒ 87

Students participated in badminton (a + b) = 45

Students participated in chess (c + b) = 61

Students who participated in both games (b) = (Students participated in badminton + Students participated in chess) - (total Students who participated)

(b) ⇒ [(a + b) + (c + b)] - (a + b + c)

(b) ⇒ (45 + 61) - 87

(b) ⇒ 106 - 87 = 19

Students who participated in badminton only (a) = (Students participated in badminton) - (Students who participated in both games)

(a) ⇒ (a + b) - (b)

(a) ⇒ 45 - 19 = 26

Hence, "26" is the correct answer.
